critique: The design specification is highly accurate and well-structured, but requires minor adjustments to ensure the SVG output perfectly matches the reference image: 1. Background Color: The reference image uses a very light gray/off-white background with a subtle grid pattern, not pure #FFFFFF. Please update the background to #F8F9FA or similar to capture the institutional 'paper' feel. 2. Skew Angle: The visual skew in the reference image appears closer to -20 degrees rather than -15 degrees. 3. Card Text Alignment: The text inside the cards is strictly centered; please update the specification to reflect 'centered' rather than 'centered or left-aligned' for the card body text. 4. Header Icon: The icon in the header is a specific 'book/document' parallelogram; please clarify that the icon should contain a simple white line graphic representing a document to match the reference.

The design specification accurately captures the visual identity of the reference image. Key strengths include: 1. Precise color identification of the Dalian University of Technology (DUT) brand blue (#003D7C). 2. Correct identification of the unique geometric motif—the -20 degree skewed parallelogram—which is consistently applied to the header icon, content cards, and decorative 'ghost' outlines. 3. Accurate layout proportions, specifically the header/footer zones and the three-column card structure. 4. Detailed description of the 'hard-edge' depth effect (offset outlines) instead of soft shadows, which is critical for reproducing this specific academic/technical style. The typography hierarchy and font stack are appropriate for the institutional context shown.
